name: What metrics should a remodeler track to measure the success of AEO?

mainEntity.name: What metrics should a remodeler track to measure the success of AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure the success of AEO, remodelers should track metrics such as organic search visibility for specific questions, the number of featured snippets or direct answers captured, voice search impressions, website traffic driven by informational queries, and conversion rates from those informational visitors. Monitoring keyword rankings for question-based queries, click-through rates (CTR) from answer boxes, and the overall increase in qualified leads originating from organic search are also key indicators of a successful AEO strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodelers should track organic visibility for questions, featured snippet count, voice search impressions, informational traffic, and conversion rates to measure AEO success.
